_comment: Edge caching strategy for BMBA. Absorbs match-day / quiz / campaign peaks so bursts never hit the origin.

rules.name: Static assets long TTL
rules.comment: Versioned by content hash (index-*.js) so long TTL is safe.

rules.name: Public API GET short TTL + stale-while-revalidate
rules.comment: 10–60s TTL absorbs peak reads on match day; ranking updates invalidate via purge.

rules.name: Never cache identity/sensitive
rules.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/wallet/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/payments/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/admin/") or http.request.headers contains x-user-id or http.request.headers contains authorization
rules.comment: Authentication, wallets, payments, admin — never at the edge.

purge_strategy.on_deploy: purge index.html and any changed static keys
